overview: Nvidia turmoil weighs on tech stocks as Fed inflation warnings intensify; domestic wind power tops 100 billion yuan, with lower-tier markets and hard tech advancing in parallel

articles.title: Commemoration of Sun Yat-sen's 160th Birthday Held in Beijing
articles.summary: A commemorative meeting marking the 160th anniversary of Sun Yat-sen's birth was held in Beijing, with Xi Jinping attending and delivering a keynote address.
articles.detail: The meeting took place in Beijing, with Xi Jinping delivering a keynote speech. No further details were provided in the source material; the core message is honoring the pioneer and building consensus.
articles.impact: Signals an effort to carry forward the spirit of patriotism and national rejuvenation and to build consensus at home and abroad.

articles.title: China's Annual Offshore Wind Power Generation Tops 100 Billion kWh
articles.summary: China's annual offshore wind power generation has surpassed 100 billion kilowatt-hours, with the industry chain continuing to extend into deeper, farther waters.
articles.detail: Annual offshore wind generation has exceeded 100 billion kWh as the industry chain pushes into deep and distant sea areas, with installed capacity and output continuing to expand.
articles.impact: Marks a new phase in large-scale clean energy development and drives the deep-and-far-sea equipment and operations and maintenance supply chain.

articles.title: China Economic Roundtable Discusses New Outlook for Agriculture, Rural Areas and Farmers
articles.summary: The China Economic Roundtable focused on the 'three rural issues,' with participants discussing a new outlook for agricultural and rural development.
articles.detail: The event took the form of a roundtable dialogue, exploring new changes and directions in the development of agriculture, rural areas and farmers.
articles.impact: Provides public opinion support and ideas for agricultural modernization and rural revitalization.

articles.title: County-Level Tourism Gains Momentum, Delivering Multi-Sector Wins in Lower-Tier Markets
articles.summary: County-level tourism continues to heat up, driving consumption in lower-tier markets and delivering wins across multiple industries.
articles.detail: A series of reports observing lower-tier markets points to county-level tourism driving multi-sector gains across culture and tourism, dining and retail.
articles.impact: Expanding county-level consumption could become a new pillar of domestic demand growth.

articles.title: Inner Mongolia Builds Institutional Framework for Pilot Free Trade Zone
articles.summary: Inner Mongolia has established an institutional framework for building a pilot free trade zone, forming a comprehensive support system.
articles.detail: Inner Mongolia is using institutional opening-up as a lever to construct the core architecture of its pilot free trade zone.
articles.impact: Helps advance institutional opening-up and regional economic cooperation in border areas.

articles.title: Asia-Pacific Needs More Mutual Trust and Cooperation
articles.summary: On Asia-Pacific development, multiple parties are calling for stronger mutual trust and cooperation to advance shared regional prosperity.
articles.detail: Commentary focused on the Asia-Pacific region, stressing that mutual trust and cooperation are the precondition for regional stability and development.
articles.impact: Reflects rising demand for Asia-Pacific cooperation, which bodes well for multilateral economic and trade coordination.

articles.title: Putin Meets US Presidential Envoy to Lay Out Position on Russia-Ukraine Conflict
articles.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin met with a US presidential envoy in Moscow, setting out Russia's position and conditions for resolving the Russia-Ukraine conflict.
articles.detail: Putin said Russia would not accept foreign troops stationed inside Ukraine and described such forces as legitimate targets for the Russian military. The envoy's side said all issues were discussed in detail, a move that will influence negotiations next week.
articles.impact: Negotiating positions differ sharply, leaving short-term prospects for a ceasefire uncertain.

articles.title: Houthis Say Saudi Warplanes Strike Multiple Locations Across Yemen
articles.summary: A Houthi spokesperson said Saudi warplanes sortied and fired missiles, hitting multiple locations across Yemen.
articles.detail: According to the Houthi spokesperson, aircraft took off from multiple bases over the past 24 hours, with missiles fired from the direction of Jizan, striking Lahej, Taiz, Saada, al-Jawf and Marib, among other areas.
articles.impact: Signals that regional conflict intensity remains high, warranting attention to security risks along the Red Sea corridor.

articles.title: French and German Leaders Agree De Cos Should Succeed as ECB President
articles.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron and German Chancellor Friedrich Merz agreed that De Cos should succeed Christine Lagarde as president of the European Central Bank.
articles.detail: The French and German leaders reached consensus on the next ECB president, backing De Cos to replace Lagarde.
articles.impact: The direction of the transition in European monetary policy leadership is becoming clearer, shaping expectations for eurozone policy.

articles.title: Belgian PM Convenes Inner Cabinet to Discuss Budget Issues
articles.summary: Belgium's prime minister will convene core cabinet members on Friday for a focused discussion on budget-related issues.
articles.detail: The meeting centers on budget matters and is limited to inner cabinet members; specific proposals were not disclosed in the source material.
articles.impact: A prolonged budget deadlock could weigh on the country's fiscal policy and market confidence.

articles.title: PBOC Q3 Policy Report Breaks Down Surge in Non-Bank Deposits and Where the Money Went
articles.summary: The People's Bank of China's Q3 monetary policy report analyzes fund flows, noting that the surge in non-bank deposits does not equate to idle capital circulation.
articles.detail: The report explains the drivers behind the rise in non-bank deposits, stressing they should not be simply equated with capital arbitrage, and breaks down where the funds actually went.
articles.impact: Helps clear up market misconceptions about idle capital circulation and stabilizes policy expectations.

articles.title: Most Domestic Commodity Futures Rise in Night Session, Chemicals Lead Gains
articles.summary: Most contracts closed higher in the night session of the domestic commodity futures market, with chemicals posting the biggest gains.
articles.detail: Most commodities finished up in night trading, with the chemicals sector leading the advance.
articles.impact: Strength in chemicals may reflect restocking and cost-side support; sustainability of the rally warrants attention.

articles.title: Post-P2P Crackdown, Whale App Accused of Secret Deposit-Taking Disguise; Multiple Payment Channels Implicated
articles.summary: The Whale App has gone offline, accused of raising deposits covertly under a new guise after the P2P wind-down, with multiple payment channels drawn into the case.
articles.detail: Reports say the Whale App has disappeared and was covertly taking deposits under a new identity after the industry-wide P2P cleanup, implicating several payment channels.
articles.impact: Signals that clearing internet finance risks remains an ongoing task and that compliance screening of payment channels needs urgent strengthening.

articles.title: Indonesia's RMB Clearing Bank Officially Opens
articles.summary: An RMB clearing bank in Indonesia officially opened in Jakarta, with Bank of China serving as the clearing bank.
articles.detail: The RMB clearing bank in Indonesia officially opened in Jakarta on the 12th, with Bank of China as the clearing agent; around 100 representatives from government departments, enterprises and financial institutions of both countries attended.
articles.impact: Supports cross-border use of the renminbi and deepens regional financial infrastructure connectivity.

articles.title: Tax Incentives and Compliance Support Help Hard-Tech Firms Accelerate
articles.summary: Tax policy support and compliance safeguards are helping hard-tech enterprises speed up their growth.
articles.detail: The report focuses on how tax services power hard-tech companies, while compliance systems guard their development.
articles.impact: Benefits hard-tech firms by cutting costs and boosting efficiency, strengthening the industrial innovation ecosystem.

articles.title: Industrial Securities: Further Downside for Gold Prices May Be Limited
articles.summary: A research note from Industrial Securities argues that, before new signals of rate-hike expectations emerge, further downside for gold prices is relatively limited.
articles.detail: The note says gold is likely to trade range-bound in the short term amid a strong dollar and high interest rates, with investment demand for the metal still influenced by real rates and other factors.
articles.impact: Offers a reference for gold asset allocation; prices may hold in a range in the near term.

articles.title: County-Level Headquarters Spawn 'Reception Room' Effect
articles.summary: The county-level headquarters economy keeps growing, generating a reception-room-style clustering and spillover effect.
articles.detail: The report observes the shape of the county-level headquarters economy, noting it is forming a 'reception room' effect that attracts converging resources.
articles.impact: Provides a replicable model for county-level industrial upgrading and investment promotion.

articles.title: Nvidia Leadership Shake-Up Sends Shares Lower, Founder's Wealth Slashes Billions
articles.summary: The founder has stepped down as CEO and from other posts, with Nvidia shares under sustained pressure and his fortune shrinking sharply based on public stake data.
articles.detail: On the evening of November 12, Nvidia's founder resigned as CEO, president and director, and the stock remained under pressure. The U.S. Department of Justice launched an antitrust investigation into Nvidia, while reports said there was no sign the DOJ planned a criminal case; the interim CEO has convened the executive team.
articles.impact: Compounding corporate governance and regulatory uncertainty may continue to weigh on sentiment across the semiconductor sector in the short term.

articles.title: U.S. Stocks Extend Gains, Nasdaq 100 Hits Intraday Record
articles.summary: All three major U.S. indices climbed, with the Nasdaq 100 rising to a fresh intraday high after opening lower.
articles.detail: The S&P 500, Nasdaq and Dow Jones all extended gains; the Nasdaq 100 rose 0.5% to an intraday record, having earlier fallen as much as 1.5% at the open.
articles.impact: Strong dip-buying appetite is evident; volatility has picked up but sentiment is recovering.

articles.title: AMD and Broadcom Extend Gains, Lead S&P 500 Higher
articles.summary: AMD and Broadcom widened their advances to more than 7%, becoming the leading gainers in the S&P 500.
articles.detail: Related semiconductor stocks extended intraday gains to over 7%, leading the S&P 500 higher.
articles.impact: Divergence is emerging within the sector as capital may rotate into peer names amid turmoil in the bellwether.

articles.title: Euro Slides to Lowest Level Since April 2025 Against Dollar
articles.summary: The euro fell to its lowest level against the dollar since April 2025, latest down 0.27% at $1.1059.
articles.detail: The euro continued to weaken against the dollar, down 0.27% at $1.1059, a low last seen in April 2025.
articles.impact: A weaker euro supports exports but heightens imported inflation and policy pressures.

articles.title: Goolsbee: Inflation Report Not a One-Off
articles.summary: Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee said he sees signs of traditional overheating demand, and the hot inflation report is not a one-time event.
articles.detail: Goolsbee said a clear-headed view of inflation data and the Fed's response is necessary, adding that the central bank is gradually entering a historically difficult period.
articles.impact: Signals the easing path may be blocked, with rate expectations continuing to roil global risk assets.

articles.title: London Cocoa Futures Jump More Than 3%
articles.summary: London cocoa futures rose more than 3% to 4,011 pounds per metric ton.
articles.detail: London cocoa futures gained over 3% intraday, at 4,011 pounds per metric ton.
articles.impact: Higher cocoa prices could push up raw material costs for downstream food producers.

articles.title: Mercedes-Benz Weighs Closing Some Plants in Germany
articles.summary: Mercedes-Benz is considering closing some of its plants in Germany, drawing industry attention.
articles.detail: Reports only mention that Mercedes-Benz is weighing closures of certain German plants; the specific scope and timeline were not disclosed.
articles.impact: If implemented, it would signal a contraction in Europe's auto industry, affecting local employment and supply chains.

articles.title: SpaceX Plans Massive Supercomputing Campus Investment
articles.summary: SpaceX plans to build supercomputing facilities in Arizona and the Rio Grande Valley, with investment running into the tens of billions of dollars.
articles.detail: SpaceX plans to build a $50 billion supercomputing campus in Arizona, creating 6,500 jobs; it will also invest more than $24 billion in new supercomputing infrastructure at Starbase in the Rio Grande Valley.
articles.impact: Compute infrastructure is becoming a focal point of competition among tech giants, driving demand across related supply chains.

articles.title: 从Token热销看智能消费新动能
articles.summary: 智能消费相关Token在电商大促期间热销，折射出智能消费新动能加速释放。
articles.detail: 报道以电商大促期间Token热销现象为切口，观察智能消费领域的新增长动能。
articles.impact: 智能消费有望成为拉动内需与AI落地的结合点。

articles.title: 赛博街景无人机交警 空中外卖落地深圳
articles.summary: 赛博街景、无人机交警、空中外卖等新业态齐现，深圳成为智能制造与低空应用样板。
articles.detail: 报道以深圳为观察对象，展示赛博街景、无人机交警、空中外卖等新场景。
articles.impact: 为智慧城市与低空经济提供可推广的城市场景实践。

articles.title: 北京范式领航商业航天
articles.summary: 北京以范式引领商业航天产业发展，形成可借鉴的发展模式。
articles.detail: 报道聚焦北京在商业航天领域的模式探索，以范式化路径推动产业发展。
articles.impact: 有助于商业航天规模化、规范化发展，吸引产业集聚。

articles.title: 成都智能网联汽车产业对接活动举行
articles.summary: 成都举办智能网联汽车产业1+N对接活动，车企透露广州车展将推纯电版新车型。
articles.detail: 成都智能网联汽车产业1+N对接活动举行，曾清林在活动中透露广州车展将推出奕境X9纯电版。
articles.impact: 推动产业链上下游对接，加速西南地区智能网联汽车产业落地。

articles.title: 上海先进制造业大会：打造全球领先智能制造体系
articles.summary: 上海市先进制造业大会召开，提出打造全球领先智能制造体系的目标。
articles.detail: 大会聚焦先进制造业发展，围绕打造全球领先智能制造体系展开部署与交流。
articles.impact: 强化上海制造能级定位，带动长三角产业升级。

articles.title: The Vitamin Chinese People Lack Most — Women More Deficient Than Men
articles.summary: The article focuses on widespread vitamin deficiencies in China, noting that women are more deficient than men.
articles.detail: The article examines vitamin intake levels across China, highlighting that deficiencies are more pronounced among women than men.
articles.impact: Raises public awareness of nutritional supplementation and boosts interest in related health consumer products.

articles.title: 48 Hours After Flu Strikes: Picking the Right Drug Is Key
articles.summary: During peak flu season, a patient shares their experience of choosing the right medication within 48 hours of symptom onset.
articles.detail: The article recounts in the first person the process of selecting flu medication during the critical 48 hours after onset.
articles.impact: Highlights the time-sensitivity of antiviral treatment and helps the public respond to flu season more effectively.

articles.title: Are Stem Cell Infusions for Anti-Aging Really Effective?
articles.summary: The article examines stem cell infusion procedures costing hundreds of thousands of yuan and questions the scientific evidence behind their anti-aging claims.
articles.detail: The report uses stem cell infusions as a case study, focusing on the efficacy and controversy behind high-priced anti-aging treatments.
articles.impact: Sparks discussion on the regulatory compliance of commercialized regenerative medicine and the protection of consumer rights.

articles.title: Intangible Heritage Enters Everyday Life: Traditional Crafts Reach Modern Living
articles.summary: Intangible cultural heritage is blending into everyday life, with traditional crafts finding their way into modern living.
articles.detail: The report observes how intangible heritage is integrating with daily life, showcasing the new face of traditional crafts in contemporary society.
articles.impact: Drives mutual empowerment between cultural tourism consumption and cultural heritage preservation.

articles.title: 300 Days and Nights in a Boot Camp School
articles.summary: The report documents 300 days in a controversial disciplinary training school, focusing on such education models and youth development issues.
articles.detail: The article follows a chronological account of experiences inside a boot camp school, centering on the social debate surrounding these institutions.
articles.impact: Prompts reflection on youth education approaches and the regulation of such institutions.
